tool_args.rationale: The W3 supply-bullwhip bridge maps to the inland-hub siphon, and the hydraulic twin supplies a transferable rho range. However, all five pilot rows share one sink gradient, leaving the gradient dependence and open branch ambiguous. The targeted open-branch probe addresses that ambiguity at the lowest relevant cost.

considered_alternatives.option: Fit the inland-hub siphon directly from the pilot
considered_alternatives.rejected_reason: The pilot fixes s_grad at 1, so the sink coefficient and overall capacity are not separately identifiable; the branch sign also needs discrimination.
The supply-bridge and flux-conservation signatures point to the static inland-hub siphon, not the coupled memory ODE; this probe costs more.
It is unrelated to the missing sink-gradient and branch information.
